data.narrative:
T1 Energy, a public-stage Climate & Energy company that has raised over $1B, is valued against a peer set of four same-sector, same-stage comparables: QuantumScape ($3.6B), Enovix ($1.0B), Solid Power ($504M), and LanzaTech ($73M). The broader Climate & Energy frontier-tech universe includes 1 additional public comparable and 8 private peers tracked.

The peer-median method, the applicable triangulation approach given available data, yields an implied valuation of $752M. This median reflects the midpoint of a distributed peer set with substantial dispersion—ranging from $73M at the low end (LanzaTech) to $3.6B at the high end (QuantumScape)—reflecting differentiated technology maturity, capital intensity, and commercialization timelines across battery and energy transition platforms.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $639M to $865M, centered on $752M. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the peer cohort given the heterogeneity within frontier energy technologies, the lack of fundamental multiples (revenue, EBITDA) to cross-check against comparable valuations, and exposure to commodity pricing and commercialization execution risk common to the sector. Investors should weight this peer-derived range against company-specific technical and market milestones.
